verdict.rationale: Claude's own Artifacts feature turns natural-language descriptions into content, and the documented examples include SVG images and diagrams. That is a thin, vector/code-rendered form of image generation. Image uploads (JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP) cover understanding images, not generating them, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: native raster/photographic image generation from prompts, any documented editing of existing images, and independent or hands-on corroboration of image output quality.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can generate and edit images from natural-language prompts
